user_scope.boundary: internal call_id isolation plus model arithmetic-intent blocking

root_causes.problem: The terminal envelope exposed CALL identifiers while report prose rejected them.
root_causes.resolution: Expose turn-scoped alphabetic chart_source_key values and map them to internal call_id values deterministically after model output.

root_causes.problem: The runtime model-facing final-response Schema still required chart_requests.call_id.
root_causes.resolution: Project a versioned model-side control Schema containing chart_source_key; keep the frozen program-side FinalReportResponse unchanged.

root_causes.problem: The frozen report Prompt instructed the model to cite internal CALL values.
root_causes.resolution: Create a new versioned Prompt and project it only in the V2.3.4.2 model-visible boundary; do not edit the frozen Prompt.

root_causes.problem: Multi-tool continuation messages exposed internal_call_id, FACT call_id and source_result_path.
root_causes.resolution: Remove those program-only fields from outbound tool-message content and fail closed if any CALL value remains.

root_causes.problem: Numeric token membership allowed a rank value to justify an unrelated derived metric value.
root_causes.resolution: Add claim-local metric-intent and numeric-unit role validation before the unchanged formal report validator.

root_causes.problem: Arithmetic validation could run before structural slot binding and hide the root structural failure.
root_causes.resolution: Freeze error precedence as model Schema/alias, slot binding, arithmetic intent, formal report validation, chart construction.

root_causes.problem: A shared frozen Agent file was initially modified to inject the model-side Schema, breaking a historical hash audit.
root_causes.resolution: Restore the frozen file byte-for-byte and perform projection inside the versioned V2.3.4.2 client boundary.

root_causes.problem: The old offline model double required internal FACT fields and the first new Mock report omitted dimension values required by Harness completeness.
root_causes.resolution: Use a V2.3.4.2-only model double that reads public FACT fields and emits complete evidence-backed dimensions without weakening Harness.

root_causes.problem: The first public alias implementation reused source_alpha and its siblings in every turn, so a stale alias could silently bind to a new turn's tool result.
root_causes.resolution: Derive each non-sensitive public alias from the current session, turn and source index; a prior-turn alias is now unknown in the current registry and fails closed.

root_causes.problem: The public alias prose guard checked the report title and claims but omitted chart titles.
root_causes.resolution: Apply the same alias-output guard to report titles, claim statements and chart titles.

root_causes.problem: The visibility transport stopped a leaking request before recording its audit row, so an empty audit could appear clean.
root_causes.resolution: Record the detected leak count before failing closed, and prevent the leaking request from reaching the provider.

root_causes.problem: Offline and Q02 summaries hard-coded successful visibility and evidence-preservation values instead of deriving them from saved traces.
root_causes.resolution: Compute leak counts and raw/parsed/mapped preservation flags from actual transport and terminal traces.

root_causes.problem: After a real authority was consumed and stopped, the checkpoint state also blocked safe offline Mock replay.
root_causes.resolution: Permit offline injected-transport replay in the consumed-failed state while keeping the consumed real authority permanently closed.

arithmetic_intent_guard.stage: after structural slot binding and before formal report validation

next_gate.reason: The authorized Q02 stopped at the first model tool-plan decision. Review Prompt semantics and the frozen Q02 plan offline before deciding whether a new checkpoint is warranted.
